question_vi: Khi nào nên dùng Server Component, khi nào dùng Client Component?
question_en: When should you use a Server Component vs a Client Component?
answer_vi: Server Component khi cần: data fetching, access backend resources, keep sensitive info (API keys), reduce client bundle. Client Component khi cần: onClick, onChange event handlers, useState/useEffect, browser APIs, real-time updates, custom hooks. Default là Server, chỉ dùng 'use client' khi thực sự cần interactivity.
answer_en: Use a Server Component when you need: data fetching, access to backend resources, keeping sensitive data (API keys) off the client, or reducing the client bundle. Use a Client Component when you need: onClick/onChange event handlers, useState/useEffect, browser APIs, real-time updates, or custom hooks. Default to Server; only add 'use client' when interactivity is truly required.
